extraction.Name: Harry Moran
extraction.Recorded patent: The instrument was recorded by Herman L. Bode on June 7, 1920
extraction.Buyer: Mortgage for $450.00 in favor of Christ Young; on May 25, 1921 Mr. Moran and wife conveyed the land by deed to Thomas R. Reynolds for $1.00 and other valuable consideration, subject to the foregoing mortgage
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 739641 issued; southwest quarter of section 24, township 43, range 27; no receipt of record for patent; mortgage executed June 4, 1920

extraction.Name: Narcisse Moran
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded by Richard Jones on April 17, 1920
extraction.Buyer: Moran and wife conveyed this land to Ed Haisch for $1.00 and other valuable consideration
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 739643 issued; northwest quarter of section 24, township 43, range 27; receipt for patent signed by the allottee April 8, 1920; deed conveyed on April 16, 1920
